faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Cantonment Board Ramgarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 12 November 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Cantonment Board Ramgarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Cantonment Board Ramgarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 12 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Cantonment Board Office Ramgarh, Jharkhand.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium Rs. 63,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS from an institution recognised by the Medical Council of India.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates must attend regularly, and discharge assigned duties. Posting may be changed in the interest of administration and the public.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement on a contractual basis. Working hours 09:00 AM to 03:00 PM (6 hours). Leave: 10 days of government holidays as per Health Department norms.
